subject.title: fix(compaction): emit after_compaction on no-op and use JSON-safe validator delimiters (#81925)

question: Should successful no-op compactions become observable as `after_compaction` events with `compactedCount: 0` and optional `reason`, given the existing plugin hook contract and the open summary-payload PR?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and source-backed, but the observable hook delivery and payload shape are public plugin API behavior that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept No-Op After Events
options.body: Approve this PR's balanced event semantics and optional `reason` field, then let normal merge gates decide the exact head.

options.title: Keep Events, Narrow Payload
options.body: Require no-op `after_compaction` delivery but remove or hide public `reason` until hook payload direction is settled.

options.title: Pause For Hook API Direction
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define the combined `after_compaction` payload shape with the open summary-payload work.

recommendation.title: Accept No-Op After Events
recommendation.body: Approve this PR's balanced event semantics and optional `reason` field, then let normal merge gates decide the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is plugin API and gateway/schema compatibility, and steipete has the strongest recent history across those touched surfaces.
